import pandas as pd
import seaborn as sns
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

df = pd.read_csv('data/coffee_sales.csv')

# Calculate total revenue per product
product_revenue = df.groupby('product')['total'].sum().sort_values(ascending=False)

# Create horizontal bar chart
plt.figure(figsize=(12, 8))
sns.barplot(x=product_revenue.values, y=product_revenue.index, orient='h', palette='viridis')
plt.xlabel('Total Revenue ($)', fontsize=12)
plt.ylabel('Product', fontsize=12)
plt.title('Total Revenue by Product (Top 10)', fontsize=14)
plt.tick_params(axis='y', labelsize=10)
plt.grid(axis='x', linestyle='--', alpha=0.7)
plt.tight_layout()

plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
